title: Delos
identity: Shoichi Yabuta’s Delos is a seven-movement alto saxophone and piano work in Zen-On’s Sugawa Saxophone Collection, SEO-030 / product 560030. The score preface gives a duration of about 13 minutes, commission by Nobuya Sugawa, and 2021 premiere by Sugawa and pianist Minako Koyanagi.

evidence.claim: EAMDC's publisher announcement documents the commission, premiere, and contrasting movement textures.
Zen-On retailer listing gives the publication details and page count.

Zen-On’s public 34-page ActiBook sample for product 560030 was visually inspected, including preface pages 3–4 and score pages 5–8. The preface describes seven contrasting movements and identifies the saxophone/piano roles; the score opening shows an active, slurred alto line over strongly accented piano sonorities, and a later sampled passage contains denser flowing saxophone figures with sustained/slurred groupings and changing dynamics. These observations apply only to the pages seen.
evidence.source_name: Zen-On official public Delos score trial, product 560030

score_observations: The publisher preface identifies seven movements with marked contrasts, including a piano solo, a lyrical saxophone movement, a movement built around held saxophone notes, a rhythmic movement, and a finale derived from movement I. In the inspected opening score page, the alto saxophone line uses active slurred figures while the piano has strongly accented chordal writing and very low-register material. A later inspected page includes denser flowing saxophone figures, sustained/slurred groups, and changing dynamics. No complete range claim is made.
review_focus: Inference from the publisher preface and inspected excerpts: assess movement-to-movement contrast, coordination across solo/lyrical/rhythmic textures, and control of the active slurred line against the piano’s strongly articulated accompaniment.

listening.description: Sugawa performance listing identified; recording not auditioned.
listening.verification: Page describes the performance and artist.

score_links.description: Official publisher ActiBook sample; inspected the preface and representative opening/later notation pages.

gaps: The public sample allowed inspection of selected opening and later pages, not the complete score; full range and unshown material remain unknown.
